feed_summary: Next.js released an out-of-band security update on October 14 that fixes two critical flaws allowing unauthenticated remote code execution, along with a high-severity denial-of-service flaw. title: Next.js Ships Out-of-Band Patch for Two Critical RCE Flaws in Caching and SVG Processing
